ttps.name: Technique Name
ttps.detection_logic: CWPP Runtime Detection Logic
ttps.cwpp_rule: Cloud CWPP Rule Signature
ttps.exception_rationale: Exception & Whitelist Rationale

ttps.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Resource Name
ttps.detection_logic: Compares resource metadata names against namespaces; alerts when system prefixes appear outside system namespaces.
ttps.cwpp_rule: Defender: Executable detected in cmdline; Google: modified malicious binary
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude verified system controllers deployed via GitOps in core namespaces.

ttps.name: Masquerading: Masquerade Account Name
ttps.detection_logic: Identifies creation of user accounts or service accounts mimicking internal system account nomenclature.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser; RHACS: User Account Anomaly
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude authorized IAM directory synchronization service accounts.

ttps.name: Network Service Discovery
ttps.detection_logic: Hooks connect() and socket() syscalls to catch rapid sequential SYN probes across RFC 1918 internal subnets.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Recon:EC2/Portscan; Google CTD: port_scan_detected
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude approved network discovery scanners and service mesh health probes.

ttps.name: Scheduled Task/Job: Container Cronjob
ttps.detection_logic: Monitors Kubernetes CronJob creations executing inline shell scripts, curl commands, or network downloads.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Execution:Kubernetes/AnomalousBehavior; Defender: Kubernetes CronJob anomaly
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude scheduled batch processing jobs managed by central CI/CD.

ttps.name: Command and Scripting: Container Admin Tool
ttps.detection_logic: Intercepts execution of docker, podman, crictl, or kubectl CLI binaries from inside container workloads.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Execution:Runtime/SuspiciousTool; Defender: Tool launched inside container
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude designated administrative bastion pods and build runner workers.

ttps.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
ttps.detection_logic: Catches kernel exploitation including dirty COW, unshare user namespace, and cgroup release_agent overwrites.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: PrivilegeEscalation:Runtime/RuncContainerEscape; RHACS: Privilege Escalation Attempt
ttps.exception_rationale: Zero production workload exemptions permitted.

ttps.name: Permission Groups Discovery
ttps.detection_logic: Flags rapid API enumeration of ClusterRoles, ClusterRoleBindings, and RoleBindings by non-admin identities.
ttps.cwpp_rule: Defender: Kubernetes RBAC enumeration; Google: discovery_api_query
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude continuous compliance audit operators (Gatekeeper, Falco exporters).

ttps.name: Indicator Removal
ttps.detection_logic: Alerts on modification or truncation of /var/log, shell history zeroing, or stopping auditing daemons.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: DefenseEvasion:Runtime/SuspiciousCommand; RHACS: Log Tampering Detected
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude automated log rotation daemons (logrotate, fluentbit cleanup).

ttps.name: Valid Accounts: Default Accounts
ttps.detection_logic: Alerts on requests initiated using default service accounts or system:anonymous credentials against API server.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Policy:Kubernetes/AnonymousAccessGranted; Defender: Anonymous user request
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude public unauthenticated readiness probe endpoints (/healthz, /livez).

ttps.name: Valid Accounts: Local Accounts
ttps.detection_logic: Detects authentication using local node accounts instead of central federated enterprise identity providers.
ttps.cwpp_rule: Defender: Local account logon to cluster node; GuardDuty: UnauthorizedAccess:EC2
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude initial bootstrap automation during declared maintenance windows.

ttps.name: Account Manipulation: Additional Cluster Roles
ttps.detection_logic: Tracks RBAC mutations granting cluster-admin or wildcard verbs to workloads outside kube-system.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: PrivilegeEscalation:Kubernetes/RoleBindingCreated
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude automated deployments executed by authorized CI/CD release agents.

ttps.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
ttps.detection_logic: Tracks repeated failed authentication attempts against SSH node ports or container management interfaces.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: UnauthorizedAccess:EC2/SSHBruteForce; Defender: Brute force attack on node
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude synthetic external connectivity monitoring probes.

ttps.name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
ttps.detection_logic: Identifies single password validation attempts distributed across multiple service accounts within short intervals.
ttps.cwpp_rule: Defender: Password spray detected; GuardDuty: CredentialAccess:IAMUser
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude centralized password rotation verification automated workflows.

ttps.name: Brute Force: Credential Stuffing
ttps.detection_logic: Correlates high-volume failed authentication attempts originating from known malicious threat proxy networks.
ttps.cwpp_rule: Defender: High volume login failure from suspicious IP; Google: credential_stuffing_attempt
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude corporate vulnerability scanners during announced test windows.

ttps.name: External Remote Services
ttps.detection_logic: Identifies exposure of Kubernetes API server, kubelet port, or cluster dashboards directly to public Internet subnets.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Policy:Kubernetes/ExposedDashboard; Defender: Publicly exposed Kubernetes API
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude explicitly authorized edge ingress controllers restricted by IP allowlists.

ttps.name: Create Account: Local Account
ttps.detection_logic: Hooks useradd, adduser, and chpasswd executions inside active running container filesystems.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Persistence:Runtime/SensitiveFileModified; RHACS: Local Account Created in Pod
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude base container image build pipelines executed within ephemeral CI runners.

ttps.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
ttps.detection_logic: Correlates ingress web exploit attempts with subsequent child process generation (e.g., java spawning sh).
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Execution:Runtime/AnomalousProcess; Defender: Web application command injection
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude authorized penetration testing exercises with formal notification.

ttps.name: User Execution: Malicious Image
ttps.detection_logic: Alerts on pods launching container images from public unvetted registries or with critical CVE vulnerabilities.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Execution:Kubernetes/MaliciousFile; Defender: Malicious image detected
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude approved local developer test sandboxes isolated from banking data.

ttps.name: Data Destruction
ttps.detection_logic: Catches mass file deletion, shredding commands (rm -rf /*, shred), or volume formatting inside workloads.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Impact:Runtime/DataDestruction; RHACS: Mass File System Deletion Detected
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude automated ephemeral storage scratch directory cleanup operations.

ttps.name: Inhibit System Recovery
ttps.detection_logic: Detects deletion of VolumeSnapshots, PersistentVolumeClaims, and automated backup controllers (e.g., Velero).
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Impact:Kubernetes/BackupDeleted; Defender: Cluster backup resource tampering
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude scheduled backup retention lifecycle pruning jobs executed by Velero.

ttps.name: Resource Hijacking: Compute Hijacking
ttps.detection_logic: Flags sustained 100% CPU thread consumption combined with Stratum cryptocurrency protocol DNS requests.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: CryptoCurrency:Runtime/BitcoinTool.B; Google CTD: cryptomining_detected
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude scheduled stress testing and mathematical risk simulations.

ttps.name: Resource Hijacking: Bandwidth Hijacking
ttps.detection_logic: Identifies abnormal egress network traffic volumes towards external peer-to-peer or anonymized proxy endpoints.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Behavior:EC2/TrafficVolumeUnusual; Defender: Large outbound data transfer
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude bulk cross-region database replication and snapshot archive backups.

ttps.name: Network Denial of Service
ttps.detection_logic: Detects rapid volumetric outbound UDP/TCP packet bursts generated from compromised pods targeting external hosts.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Backdoor:EC2/DenialOfService.Udp; Defender: Outbound DDoS activity
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude load testing traffic generated from isolated load testing node pools.

ttps.name: Endpoint Denial of Service
ttps.detection_logic: Catches fork bomb processes, memory exhaustion, or pod crashes degrading node-level kubelet stability.
ttps.cwpp_rule: Defender: High memory consumption exhausting host; Google CTD: container_exhaustion
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude JVM heap size warmup routines within configured cgroup limits.

ttps.name: Implant Internal Image
ttps.detection_logic: Detects unauthorized image pushes, tag overwrites, or tampering with base images in enterprise registries.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Persistence:Kubernetes/SuspiciousImageUpdate; Defender: Image tampered in ACR
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude verified automated continuous deployment build pipeline accounts.

ttps.name: Steal Application Access Token
ttps.detection_logic: Tracks access to Kubernetes Secret objects and subsequent API usage originating from external unauthorized IPs.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: CredentialAccess:Kubernetes/SecretsAccessed
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude authorized secret synchronizers (External Secrets Operator).

ttps.name: Create or Modify System Process: Container
ttps.detection_logic: Flags modification of static pod manifests (/etc/kubernetes/manifests) or installation of systemd container units.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Persistence:Runtime/SuspiciousCommand; RHACS: Static Pod Manifest Created
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude standard Kubernetes cluster version upgrade automation procedures.

ttps.name: Alternate Auth Material: App Access Token
ttps.detection_logic: Identifies API token reuse across discordant source subnets or anomalous user-agent signature mismatches.
ttps.cwpp_rule: Defender: Anomalous token replay detected; Google: anomalous_token_use
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude multi-region automated CI/CD runners using distributed workers.

ttps.name: Unsecured Credentials: Credentials In Files
ttps.detection_logic: Intercepts unauthorized process access to /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token and .env files.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: CredentialAccess:Runtime/SensitiveFileRead; RHACS: Service Account Token Read
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude official application runtime initialization scripts accessing secrets.

ttps.name: Unsecured Credentials: Container API
ttps.detection_logic: Alerts on direct unauthenticated HTTP requests targeting kubelet read-only port 10255 or Docker daemon TCP sockets.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: CredentialAccess:Kubernetes/KubeletAPIQueried; Defender: Kubelet API abuse
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude cluster monitoring agents (cAdvisor, Prometheus node-exporter).

ttps.name: Container Administration Command
ttps.detection_logic: Audits all kubectl exec, kubectl attach, and docker exec commands initiated into production running containers.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Execution:Kubernetes/ExecIntoPod; Defender: Container interactive session started
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude pre-approved break-glass emergency troubleshooting sessions.

ttps.name: Deploy Container
ttps.detection_logic: Detects ad-hoc container creation bypassing Kubernetes admission controllers or GitOps deployment pipelines.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: Execution:Kubernetes/WorkloadDeployed; RHACS: Unmanaged Pod Deployed
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude emergency operator deployments initiated by cluster administrator credentials.

ttps.name: Escape to Host
ttps.detection_logic: Detects breakout attempts via nsenter, privileged securityContext, Docker socket mount, or hostPath /.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: PrivilegeEscalation:Runtime/RuncContainerEscape; Google CTD: container_escape
ttps.exception_rationale: Zero production workload exemptions permitted.

ttps.name: Build Image on Host
ttps.detection_logic: Alerts on invocations of docker build, nerdctl build, or buildah executed inside Kubernetes worker node shells.
ttps.cwpp_rule: Defender: Image build command executed on host node; RHACS: Node Image Build Detected
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude dedicated container build worker nodes isolated in private build subnets.

ttps.name: Container and Resource Discovery
ttps.detection_logic: Tracks extensive API querying of namespaces, pods, nodes, and configmaps by workload service accounts.
ttps.cwpp_rule: Defender: Discovery commands executed in container; Google CTD: resource_discovery
ttps.exception_rationale: Exclude core cluster components (CoreDNS, kube-proxy, Ingress controllers).

ttps.name: Disable or Modify Tools
ttps.detection_logic: Flags termination of security agent processes (Falco, GuardDuty agent, Defender daemonset) or eBPF unhooking.
ttps.cwpp_rule: GuardDuty: DefenseEvasion:Runtime/SecurityAgentTerminated; RHACS: Agent Disconnected
ttps.exception_rationale: Zero production workload exemptions permitted.
